# Composer attachment tray — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for the composer attachment tray when the draft has files and the reader needs to see them before sending. The attachments are data — id plus label — rendered as chips above the input, and each chip carries a remove button named by its attachment's label, so removing reads as removing that file. `onRemoveAttachment` is the domain action: the host drops the file and the tray only asks. There is deliberately no upload and no preview here — files arrive host-owned, the tray lists and removes but never picks, and rendering a file is the message list's job. The tray is a labelled attachments region, so its chips announce as a set rather than stray buttons.

## Native

### Features

Reach for the composer attachment tray when the draft has files and the reader needs to see them before sending — the native twin under the same contract. The attachments are data — id plus label — rendered as chips above the input, each with a labelled remove control, and `onRemoveAttachment` is the domain action: the host drops the file and the tray only asks. There is no upload and no preview: files arrive host-owned, the tray lists and removes but never picks, and rendering a file is the message list's job. The tray is a labelled attachments region, so its chips announce as a set rather than stray buttons.
